company_description:
FreshCart Supermarkets is a Croatian neighbourhood supermarket chain founded in 2008 and headquartered in Velika Gorica. It operates 46 stores across Zagreb, Zagreb County and Karlovac County, employing around 1,900 people. The company serves local communities with a focus on fresh food, fair prices and knowledgeable, helpful staff. Its “Ask the counter” promise reflects an emphasis on honest customer advice, particularly at staffed meat and deli counters.

FreshCart sources about 60% of its fresh meat from Croatian producers and manages supply through its own distribution centre and cutting room in Velika Gorica. This gives the business a strong local-producer and fresh-food focus.

The company values reliability, hygiene, friendliness and pride in good work. Store teams receive practical onboarding, including guidance from experienced butchers and paid HACCP training; relevant staff can also receive support for equipment-handling courses and professional qualifications. Counter roles prioritise experience and practical ability over formal diplomas.

The working environment is team-based and customer-facing, with shift schedules generally shared in advance and shift swaps possible through a counter lead. Busy periods, especially Saturdays, are part of the retail pace. Reported benefits include a meal allowance, staff discount, Christmas bonus and public-transport allowance.

culture_signals: Fresh local food and fair prices
Staff who know their products; honest advice on cuts and cooking
Reliability, care for hygiene, friendliness with customers, and pride in good work
Meat counter teams of 3 to 6 people working across two shifts
work_context.notes: The job ad specifies on-site work at the Zagreb-Jarun store. The careers page says experience matters more than diplomas for counter roles, while this ad requires completed butcher training or at least 2 years of meat-counter experience; the ad's requirements apply to this job.

# About FreshCart Supermarkets
*(fictional web page – freshcart.example/about)*

FreshCart is a Croatian supermarket chain founded in 2008 in Velika Gorica. It runs 46 neighbourhood supermarkets in Zagreb, Zagreb County and Karlovac County and employs about 1,900 people.

Every FreshCart store larger than 800 m² has a staffed meat and deli counter. Fresh meat comes from Croatian farms through the company's own distribution centre in Velika Gorica; deliveries reach the stores on pallets every morning before 07:00.

**What we stand for:** fresh local food, fair prices, and staff who know their products. "Ask the counter" is our promise: customers should get honest advice on cuts and cooking from trained people.

**Company facts (2026)**
- 46 stores, 31 with a service meat counter
- About 60% of fresh meat from Croatian producers
- Distribution centre in Velika Gorica with its own cutting room

results.title: Working at FreshCart
results.content:
# Working at FreshCart
*(fictional careers page – freshcart.example/careers)*

**Store teams:** each meat counter has 3 to 6 people across two shifts, led by a counter lead who reports to the store manager. New colleagues get a two-week introduction with an experienced butcher and a paid HACCP refresher.

**Training:** FreshCart pays for forklift and pallet-truck courses for store staff who handle deliveries, and supports colleagues who prepare for the master craftsman exam (majstorski ispit) with paid exam days.

**Benefits:** meal allowance, 10% staff discount, Christmas bonus, transport allowance for public transport.

**What we look for:** reliability, care for hygiene, friendliness with customers, and pride in good work. Experience matters more to us than diplomas for counter roles.

**How we hire:** a short phone call, a 30-minute meeting at the store and a trial half-day at the counter (paid).
